name: What are the common signs of a leaky toilet that might need replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a leaky toilet that might need replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a leaky toilet include hearing the toilet run when nobody has flushed it, a phantom flush where the toilet randomly refills, or visible water around the base. You might also notice unexplained increases in your water bill. These issues indicate a constant water loss, which can lead to higher utility costs and potential subfloor damage if not addressed. Early detection allows for prompt action to prevent further issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a leaky toilet include constant running, phantom flushing, visible water around the base, or an unexplained high water bill.
